notes.pitches: Four different notes (A, E, C, G) across the same A2-A5 span. v0 used four A's, which could not tell a model that follows the pitch from one that happens to like A.
notes.acceptance: max_cents_err, min_voiced_pct and min_cells_pct are unchanged from v0. Spread and dominance are new: a render must hold one steady pitch before its accuracy counts. An instrument passes on an arm when min_cells_pct of its cells are on target (ON TARGET) or at least retunable (RETUNABLE).
